items.item_text: Experience with at least one of the following: plant disease diagnosis, plant greenhouse management, or fungal microbiology.
Experience with aseptic microbiology techniques, molecuar identification, microscope use.
Hands on experience in molecular identification of microorganisms, microscope use, fungicide sensitivity evaluation.

Under general supervision provide support in the laboratory to process plant samples for disease diagnostics and pathogen survey, and manage a culture collection of bacteria, oomycete, and fungal strains. Provide assistance in media inventory and preparation. Provide support in research and molecular diagnostics of ornamental plants in California. Assist with microbial characterization of fungi and oomycete pathogens of ornamental crops. Assist with setting and maintenance of greenhouse experiments.
BS in plant science, horticulture, microbiology, plant pathology and/or related field.
Theoretical background in plant science, horticulture, microbiology, plant pathology and/or related field.
Strong time management and multitasking skills.
Good written and oral communication skills.
